result.stdout:
NumeralSystems.Net command line

Usage:
  numsys convert VALUE --from BASE --to BASE
  numsys inspect PATTERN --type TYPE
  numsys solve "CONSTRAINT[; CONSTRAINT...]" [--explain] [--limit COUNT] [--timeout MS]

Patterns use 0, 1, and ? from most-significant to least-significant bit.
Constraint operators are &, |, ^, and nand. Exit code 4 means timeout.
